title: Sources: Amazon plans to move its Prime Day sale from July to late June; the shift affects its financial reporting, with event sales coming in Q2 rather than Q3 (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Amazon plans to move its Prime Day sale from July to late June; the shift affects its financial reporting, with event sales coming in Q2 rather than Q3 — Amazon.com Inc. is moving up its annual Prime Day sale to June from July, according to people familiar with the matter …
